title: POWER JUNCTION BOX - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What is the sequence of actions required to remove and reinstall the power junction box on the firewall, including disconnecting and reconnecting all associated electrical components?
answer: Remove the Power Junction Box . (1) Remove the access plate  and disconnect the battery cables . Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (2) Remove the cover from the power junction box. (3) Disconnect the electrical connectors, cables, and ground strap from the power junction box. (4)  Remove the screws that attach the power junction box to the firewall. (5) Remove the power junction box.Install the Power Junction Box . (1) Position the power junction box on the firewall and attach it with the screws. (2) Connect the electrical connectors, cables, and ground strap to the power junction box. (3) Install the cover on the power junction box. (4) Connect the battery cables , and install the access plate . Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation.

title: POWER JUNCTION BOX - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What precautions should be taken to prevent electrical hazards when servicing the junction box on the Model 182 aircraft?
answer: General Precautions and Notes. CAUTION: Make sure that all electrical power is removed from the airplane and that the battery is disconnected before you work on components of the junction box. (1)  Individual components such as relays, transducers, and the alternator control unit can be replaced on an as-needed basis.  Refer to the Model 182 Illustrated Parts Catalog for replacement part numbers. (2) Before you disconnect the wires, identify and put a label on the wires for later installation. (3) Torque values for ground and current-carrying studs can be found in Chapter 20, Torque Data - Maintenance Practices.

title: POWER JUNCTION BOX - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What equipment and reference instructions are used to troubleshoot the power junction box?
answer: Complete the Power Junction Box Troubleshooting. (1) The power junction box troubleshooting is done with the Lamar TE04 MCU Test Set. Use the LI-0021 instructions. Refer to Electrical Power - General, Tools, Equipment, and Materials.

title: POWER JUNCTION BOX - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What is the purpose of the components contained within the power junction box installed on the forward, left side of the firewall?
answer: The power junction box, also referred to as a Master Control Unit , is installed on the forward, left side of the firewall. The power junction box has a battery relay, starter relay, alternator relay, current sensor, external power relay, alternator control unit, power distribution bus, and bus fuses .
